SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch Tihson,
REPORT
Date...Sept...29,.......19 36.
Subject Ex-students of Shanghai University form alumni association.
Made by...D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by Chuhooe S.P.9
Ex-students of the defunct Shanghai University
(上海大学 ) have organized an alumni association with a
communication address in the Ching Ping (景平) Middle School,
522 Rue Pere Proc. A meeting to inaugurate this association
was held by some sixty persons in the above mentioned school
at 3 p.m. September 28, 1936, when an executive committee of
11 persons including Ling Chun (林钧), Principal of the
"May 30" Primary School, Chapei, and a supervisory committee
of 3 persons including Wu Kai-sien (吴开先), committee
member of the local Tangpu, were elected.
It is to be noted that the Shanghai University
was originally located on Seymour Road before the May 30th
Incident in 1925, and later removed to Chapei on the
instruction of the Municipal Police. This institution was
the centre of communist propaganda at that time and its
students played leading roles during the May 30th agitation.
Sih Tse liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
（左侧批注：JBR. 29/9 S.1 K.I.V. has 15 files for seria F.C.S.C 29/9/36 30/9.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特科 Tihson，
报告
日期……1936年9月29日。
主题 上海大学前学生组建校友会。
呈报人……侦探督察 Sih Tse-liang 转呈人 Chuhooe S.P.9
已停办的上海大学（上海大学）前学生组织了一个校友会，通讯地址设在贝勒路（Rue Pere Proc）522号景平中学。1936年9月28日下午3时，约六十人在上述学校举行会议，正式成立该会，会上选举产生了由11人组成的执行委员会，其中包括闸北“五卅”小学校长林钧（Ling Chun），以及由3人组成的监察委员会，其中包括当地党部委员吴开先（Wu Kai-sien）。
值得注意的是，上海大学原址位于西摩路（Seymour Road），在1925年五卅惨案之前，后根据警务处指令迁至闸北。该机构当时是共产主义宣传的中心，其学生在五卅运动中发挥了主导作用。
Sih Tse liang
侦探督察
特科主管。
（左侧批注：JBR. 9月29日 S.1 K.I.V. 有15份档案归入 F.C.S.C 系列 1936年9月29日 9月30日。）

REPORT ON The Shanghai University.

Made by C.D.I. Givens Forwarded by DIRECTOR OF CRIMINAL INTELLIGENCE

Sir,

The Shanghai University was founded by Yu Yue Jen
(于右任) in October 1922. It was then situated in Chapei,
but having outgrown the capacity of its premises there, it
removed to 132 Seymour Road. Yu, who is now President of the
school, is an important member of the Kuomintang Party. He
first came under the notice of the police on Sept. 8, 1909,
when, as editor of the Min Hu Pao (民呼報), he was charged
with libel and embezzlement and sentenced by the Mixed Court
to expulsion from the Settlement. This decision remained in
force until April 1923 when it was rescinded. A year after its
establishment, the Shanghai University had about 300 students,
but this number increased to about 1,000 in 1926. The names of
about 50 officers and teachers appear in a register issued by
the University in 1924. These include a Russian professor of
drawing, a professor of the Russian language named Poh Dah Li
(卜達禮), who is described as a graduate of the Eastern
University, Moscow, and Jui Tsiu Bah (瞿秋白), dean of the
Sociology Department and teacher of Russian, who is described
as an ex-teacher of the Eastern University, Moscow.

The Shanghai University specializes in Chinese
and English literature, Russian language and sociology.
Subjects for lectures, delivered in the Sociology course, include
the doctrines of Sun Yat Sen and Lenin, the plans and
policy of the Kuomintang, the problems of Mongolia and
Thibet, history of the Chinese revolution, labour problems
in China, the new economic policy of Russia, the people's

呈报人 刑事侦缉督察 Givens 转呈人 刑事侦缉处处长

先生，

上海大学由于右任（Yu Yue Jen）于1922年10月创办。校址初设闸北，后因原有校舍不敷使用，迁至西摩路132号。于氏现任该校校长，系国民党重要成员。他首次引起警方注意是在1909年9月8日，当时他作为《民呼報》编辑，被控诽谤及侵吞公款，并被混合法庭判处驱逐出租界。该判决一直有效，直至1923年4月才被撤销。上海大学成立一年后，约有学生300名，但到1926年这一数字增至约1,000名。1924年大学发布的一份注册名录中列有约50名职员和教师的姓名。其中包括一名俄籍绘画教授，一名名为卜達禮（Poh Dah Li）的俄语教授，据称其为莫斯科东方大学毕业生，以及社会学系主任兼俄语教师瞿秋白（Jui Tsiu Bah），据称其为莫斯科东方大学前教员。

上海大学专攻中英文文学、俄语和社会学。社会学课程讲座的主题包括孙中山与列宁的学说、国民党的计划与政策、蒙古与西藏问题、中国革命史、中国劳工问题、俄国新经济政策、人民

to have organized a proletarian school for the poor and a
social problem research society.

There are numerous instances in which the teachers
and students of the Shanghai University came under the notice
of the Police. As already described, Yu Yue Jen, the President,
was once expelled from the Settlement. Zao Lin Tsz(趙力子),
who was Acting President during part of 1924 and 1925 during Yu's
absence in Peking, has been several times charged at the Mixed
Court and convicted in connection with extremist printed
matter published in the Min Kuo Pao(民國報), of which he is.
editor, and books emanating from the Shanghai University.
Sz Zung Tung(施存統), the teacher of Sociology in the University,
was deported from Japan for Bolshevist tendencies. Chou Kang
Shih(周剛直), a teacher of physical culture there, was
executed by the Chinese Authorities in January 1926 for propaga-
ting Bolshevism in Kiangyin(江陰). Many other teachers and
pupils of the University are known to the Police to be sympathi-
zers of Bolshevism and anti-foreign agitators, and some of the
students took a very prominent part in the promotion of unrest
in the Settlement during 1925.

The Shanghai University while in the
Settlement maintained a library and a book store which
for a time sold books and newspapers containing matters
of a grossly inflammatory nature. These publications included
the Guide Weekly(嚮導), Plans of the Communist Party

上海大学的教师和學生多次引起警方注意。如前所述，校长于右任曾被驱逐出租界。赵力子（Zao Lin Tsz）在于右任赴京期间，于1924年和1925年部分时间代理校长职务，他因在其担任编辑的《民國報》上刊登极端主义印刷品以及出版源自上海大学的书籍，多次在混合法庭被起诉并定罪。该校社会学教师施存统（Sz Zung Tung）因具有布尔什维克倾向被日本驱逐出境。该校体育教师周剛直（Chou Kang Shih）因在江陰（Kiangyin）传播布尔什维主义，于1926年1月被中国当局处决。警方知悉，该校许多其他教师和學生是布尔什维主义的同情者和反外煽动者，部分学生在1925年租界动荡局势的促成中发挥了非常显著的作用。

上海大学在租界内维持着一个图书馆和一个书店，曾在一段时间内出售含有严重煽动性内容的书籍和报纸。这些出版物包括《嚮導》周报、《共產黨底計畫》

quantity of literature of this description seized by the
police in the course of a search there on December 9, 1924,
was confiscated in accordance with an order made by the Mixed
